title: New Synthesis Series Launched
bodyHtml:
A Reimagining of the classic D-Shape

The Synthesis range embodies a modern take on the classic D-shape, redesigned for the contemporary bathroom with Italian flair.

Synthesis features a timeless design - bold lines and soft curves packed with clever functionality, perfect for the design-conscious. Synthesis includes a variety of installation options to suit your style, from wall-hung installations to bench, and semi-recessed basins, baths and a variety of toilet styles.

Clever Functionality

Synthesis Wall-hung Basin installations are available with a clever option to add a matching towel rail, seamlessly integrating design and practicality.

A Seamless Contemporary Experience

Each piece is crafted to maintain a consistent design direction throughout the range, ensuring a cohesive and refined aesthetic.

Whether you are renovating an existing space or planning a new one, the Synthesis collection offers a seamless design solution across your ceramic fixtures.

Explore the Synthesis Range

Explore the Synthesis collection on our website today and discover the perfect blend of timeless elegance and contemporary design.
